title: ACOTH: 53 of 56 counted rows, three pair-branch rows still open
status_plain: The two-regime x87 form was promoted on a strict improvement from 35 to 53 of 56 rows with zero regressions. Three pair-branch rows and the exact switch double remain open. The catalogue maturity is M3 -- fixed, unsigned -- so this is not a signed-off surface. The corpus is the identification's own; the word used for it is "fresh", never "held out".
